# Feature Request Template

**Title:** \[Feature] Short description of the feature

**Description:**
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement.

**Rationale:**
Why is this feature needed? How will it improve Everlog?

**UI / Assets:**
Include mockups, screenshots, or other assets if applicable.

**Testing Considerations:**
Describe how you tested or plan to test this feature. Include iOS/watchOS version and whether on real devices or simulator.

**Additional Notes:**
Anything else that might help the reviewers.

**Branch Reminder:** Please target your PR to the `development` branch.
